name: Brainstorm
description: Rapid ideation: generate, build on each other, then converge.

phases.name: Seed
phases.prompt: Frame the problem. What are we brainstorming? Set constraints.

phases.name: Ideate
phases.prompt: Generate 3-5 ideas each. Be bold, no filtering yet.

phases.name: Build
phases.prompt: Pick the best idea from the other's list. Expand and improve it.

phases.name: Converge
phases.prompt: Select the top 2-3 ideas. Explain why and suggest next steps.
